summary.text: Army ants are ants carrying natural markings like human characters, made rather than born of nature by Gu Immortal great experts, which enslavement path Gu Masters use to ease their feeding problem.

claims.text: In an enslavement path dream realm, ants dig their way out of a school field after primeval stones are scattered across it, and Fang Yuan’s dragonman clone wonders aloud whether they are the legendary army ant. They are not ordinary ants: natural markings on their bodies resemble human language characters, the yellow ones carrying the word worker and the larger black ones the word soldier. Army ants and the dragonman race are alike in that nature did not produce them, since Gu Immortal great experts created them. Enslavement path Gu Masters use this type of army ant, which resolves their feeding problem to a large degree. A small number can serve for daily training, while a large group can form an ant tide of colossal power. Fang Yuan uses a killer move that enslaves ants by sight, and dozens of worker ants and soldier ants gather at his side and multiply until they outnumber those of his opponent Zhang Shuang many times over.

Army ant is the true inheritance of Green Ant Ascetic, and once Wu Shuai, the dragonman Gu Immortal whose legacy Dragon Palace holds, inherited it, he made it his main offensive method; grown to a certain number, the ants have terrifying might, enough for one to fight a group of rank eight Gu Immortals alone. Fang Yuan decides not to practice the method now, because he already has the battle strength to fight a group of rank eights alone and building an ant army from scratch would need immense resources.

Army ant is a species created by Green Ant Ascetic and is extremely suitable for enslavement path Gu Immortals, and the rank eight Immortal Gu Ant Nest that is his core Immortal Gu can breed all kinds of army ants. Fang Yuan’s dragonman clone Wu Shuai recovers Ant Nest from an inheritance the original Wu Shuai sealed at Gu tribe headquarters, together with the rank seven Letter Seal Immortal Gu, which holds a large amount of content on army ants. The queen ant of army ants can breed other ants but cannot breed another queen ant, which is a huge disadvantage. Green Ant Ascetic had been enslaved by Dragon Palace and army ant had become one of the symbols of the dragonman race, so when Duke Long ordered everything related to the exterminated dragonmen removed, army ants were implicated too and vanished from history like a shooting star. For Ant Nest to create army ants, immortal essence is only one condition, and specific immortal materials are also required.

Fang Yuan’s clone Wu Shuai accepts a lump of unmoving rotten water from a merman Gu Immortal, which he needs to raise the arrow ants among his army ants, and since he began raising army ants they have expanded at a horrifying speed. Fang Yuan invests massive resources in them, and Gu tribe and the mermen help greatly.

Over a hundred million army ants move like a golden river circling in the sky while Wu Shuai manipulates them from his dragon throne in Dragon Palace. Fed corpse emperor bird feathers, the army ants devour them and produce a new batch of corpse ants that give off death energy and grow stronger by eating the corpses of army ants, the strongest of them matching a king ant but not a queen ant. Army ants hold the essence of enslavement path, and feeding them keeps their numbers up and can even create new breeds, but they only alleviate the weakness of enslavement path and cannot eliminate it. Grown to the scale that can fight rank eight Gu Immortals, the ant army becomes a heavy burden and a bottomless hole in expenditure, and Wu Shuai reckons it would not have grown this large without the help of Gu tribe and the merfolk.

Building on Green Ant Ascetic’s method, Wu Shuai creates the killer move lingering poisonous ant plague, which lets his ants devour dao marks and refine themselves into higher ranks, though only Fang Yuan’s main body can use it.

Army ants are vicious insects in essence that can raise their strength from ordinary beast to beast king, desolate beast, ancient desolate beast, and immemorial desolate beast, and Wu Shuai elevated their essence from insect to Gu. Two ant Immortal Gu born of the ant plague, red copper fire ant and white noodle queen ant, seem to have been an arrow ant and a queen ant.
Countless army ants gather into a hollow ball around Wu Shuai and Fang Yuan while Fang Yuan focuses on his tribulation, and Spectral Soul tears their defense apart instantly.
Army ants gather into a river of ants that sweeps toward Spectral Soul.

Pressing down like a black cloud, they attack the head of Giant Spectral Soul and rush toward its eyes, nose, and ears, but the black smoke it breathes out kills large numbers of them without resistance.
Countless army ants sweep the base of a mountain like a tsunami while Wu Shuai manipulates them from outside, and Divine Emperor City sends out countless divine bean soldiers against them.

A large group of army ants forms the shape of a giant eagle and attacks Profound Literature grotto-heaven, tearing and gnawing at everything in it. Qi Sea Ancestor recognises Wu Shuai’s battlefield killer move myriad army ant nest, whose core is the rank eight Ant Nest Immortal Gu: countless army ants are first sent to corrode a blessed land or grotto-heaven, and once the corrosion reaches a certain point the battlefield activates. Inside it Wu Shuai sends army ants against the Heavenly Court Gu Immortals and sends many more to devour resources and breed rapidly. When Seven Fiendish Primeval Monarch, most of his body already melted, raises his injured fist at Qi Sea Ancestor, densely packed army ants climb up his body and he breaks apart the next moment. Then the star array calculation formation collapses, and the power of its self-detonating stars, under the control of Star Constellation Chessboard, breaks the ant nest battlefield.

Green Ant Ascetic’s will says that he created army ant and hid one weakness of the ants extremely deeply, which his traitorous disciple never knew. The killer move golden bottle drunken wine can send army ants into chaos and cause a backlash on the user.
